metadata.question: Between December 2021 and January 2022, was the mean snow cover on Villarrica greater than the 2000 to 2020 average for the same months?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare mean snow cover on Villarrica volcano between: - December 2021 to January 2022 (target period) - The 2000-2020 average for the same months (historical baseline) Strategy: 1. Use MODIS snow cover data (MOD10A1) which has NDSI_Snow_Cover band 2. Define Villarrica volcano location (Chile, -71.935, -39.42) 3. Process both periods and compare means 4. Handle potential data gaps with checks Key considerations: - MODIS Terra has data from 2000, good for historical baseline - Use NDSI_Snow_Cover band (0-100% snow cover) - Mask clouds and poor quality using the 'NDSI_Snow_Cover_Basic_QA' band - Check for empty collections and valid pixels - Compare means with proper validation Data Quality Checks: - Check collection sizes for both periods - Check valid pixel counts after masking - Validate that means are reasonable (0-100 range) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const villarrica = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.935, -39.42]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around volcano // Target period const targetStart = '2021-12-01'; const targetEnd = '2022-01-31'; // Historical period (2000-2020 for Dec-Jan) const histStart = '2000-12-01'; const histEnd = '2020-01-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Snow Cover function getSnowCollection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(12, 1, 'month')) // Dec-Jan months only .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); } // Get collections const targetCol = getSnowCollection(targetStart, targetEnd); const histCol = getSnowCollection(histStart, histEnd); // Check collection sizes const targetSize = targetCol.size().getInfo(); const histSize = histCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target period (2021-22) images: ${targetSize}`); console.log(`Historical period images: ${histSize}`); if (targetSize === 0 || histSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate means const targetMean = targetCol.mean(); const histMean = histCol.mean(); // Check valid pixels const targetCount = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); const histCount = histMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); console.log(`Target valid pixels: ${targetCount}`); console.log(`Historical valid pixels: ${histCount}`); if (targetCount === 0 || histCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean values const targetVal = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); const histVal = histMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); console.log(`Target mean snow cover: ${targetVal?.toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`Historical mean snow cover: ${histVal?.toFixed(2)}%`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (targetVal === null || histVal === null || isNaN(targetVal) || isNaN(histVal) || targetVal < 0 || targetVal > 100 || histVal < 0 || histVal > 100) { console.log("C3"); } else if (targetVal > histVal) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
